description: Add a channel alerts can be sent to, then name its id in create_alert or update_alert channelIds. kind "slack": channelId and channelName from list_slack_channels (a private channel needs the bot invited first). kind "webhook": url, optional label and headers; the signing secret comes back once, in this answer. kind "discord": url is the Discord incoming webhook URL (https://discord.com/api/webhooks/<id>/<token>, from the Discord channel's settings, Integrations, Webhooks). kind "teams": url is a Teams Workflows webhook URL (in Teams, the channel's menu, Workflows, "Send webhook alerts to a channel"); old Office 365 connector URLs are refused, Microsoft retired them. Discord and Teams URLs are write-only: answers show urlHint. Email lists are made in the dashboard or with POST /v1/channels, which send each address its confirmation link. events: attention events to receive here (mention.spike, sentiment.negative_spike, keyword.noisy, channel.failing; on a webhook also the account events), on top of what rules send.

channelId.description: slack: the channel id (C...) from list_slack_channels.

channelName.description: slack: the channel name, for the label.

events.description: Events to receive here on top of rules. Omit for none.

headers.description: webhook: extra request headers, for your own auth.

idempotencyKey.description: Optional. A unique value (a UUID) for this call: 1 to 255 visible ASCII characters, no spaces. Calling again with the same key and the same input within 24 hours returns the first result instead of doing it twice.

label.description: webhook, discord, teams: a name; the URL host (webhook) or "Discord" / "Teams" when omitted.

url.description: webhook: where the signed POSTs go. discord, teams: the incoming webhook URL.

workspaceId.description: Optional. Run this call inside one of your child workspaces (org_..., from list_workspaces) instead of your own. Applies to this call only; the result says which workspace it acted on.
